tabs.html:
Ruijie RG-EW300N 300 Mbps Wi-Fi 4 Wireless Smart Router

The Ruijie RG-EW300N is a reliable and cost-effective Wi-Fi 4 (802.11n) wireless smart router delivering up to 300Mbps speed, ideal for everyday internet use in homes and small offices. Designed for stable wireless connectivity, this router supports multiple devices simultaneously with easy setup and management features.

Key Features:

  • Wi-Fi 4 (802.11n) Standard: Provides stable wireless connection with speeds up to 300Mbps.
  • Smart Wireless: Supports multiple device connections with efficient data transmission.
  • Easy Setup: User-friendly interface for quick installation and configuration.
  • Security: Supports WPA/WPA2 encryption for secure wireless communication.
  • Compact Design: Space-saving design fits easily in any home or office environment.

Technical Specifications:

  • Wireless Speed: Up to 300Mbps
  • Wireless Standard: IEEE 802.11n (Wi-Fi 4), backward compatible with 802.11g/b
  • Frequency Band: Single-band 2.4GHz
  • Antenna: Internal high-gain antenna for reliable coverage
  • Ethernet Ports: 4 × 10/100Mbps LAN ports, 1 × 10/100Mbps WAN port
  • Security: WPA/WPA2 encryption, SPI firewall protection
  • Management: Web-based interface for easy configuration
  • Dimensions: Approx. 180 × 110 × 30 mm
  • Power Supply: DC 12V/1A (may vary)
